blocks.text: Check out this page for the latest updates on Miss Universe 2026 There will be no Asian or African representation at the judging panel for this year’s Miss Universe pageant, as Americans and Europeans dominated the group. The Miss Universe Organization (MUO) released the list of the members of the selection committee for the 75th edition of the international pageant in Puerto Rico in a reel posted on the Miss Universe Instagram page the day before the final competition.
